planets.name: HAT-P-21 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Mazaalai with a 4.12-day year, found in 2010.

text.card: HAT-P-21 b was found in 2010 by HATNet as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around Mazaalai. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
